statement: ∀ (C : Set (WSpace n)) (a b : ℝ), IsCompact C → (∀ x r, x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Icc a b → u (x,r) = q) → ∀ (k : ℕ) x r, 0 < k → x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Ioo a b → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k u (x,r) = 0
proof:
intro C a b hC hu k x r hk hx hr
have hopen : IsOpen (Cᶜ ×ˢ Set.Ioo a b) := hC.isClosed.isOpen_compl.prod isOpen_Ioo
have heq : u =ᶠ[nhds (x,r)] (fun _ => q) := by
  filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds (show (x,r) ∈ Cᶜ ×ˢ Set.Ioo a b from ⟨hx, hr⟩)] with p hp
  exact hu p.1 p.2 hp.1 ⟨hp.2.1.le, hp.2.2.le⟩
rw [(heq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)]
rfl
